slots.name: title
slots.synthetic_source_example: Why the roadmap runs in this order

slots.name: source.text
slots.synthetic_source_example: Northfield Health System digital front door program.

slots.name: node01.text
slots.synthetic_source_example: Patients feel the front door, but it only works once the data underneath it is trusted.

slots.name: node02.items.item01.text
slots.synthetic_source_example: Every later feature needs one patient ID.

slots.name: node02.items.item02.text
slots.synthetic_source_example: Booking creates the demand that estimates and billing serve.

slots.name: node02.items.item03.text
slots.synthetic_source_example: Clinical workflows change slowest, so we start them early but ship them last.

slots.name: node06.text
slots.synthetic_source_example: One master patient index and one sign-in across all six hospitals.

slots.name: node08.text
slots.synthetic_source_example: Two registration flows create duplicates and denials today.

slots.name: node10.text
slots.synthetic_source_example: Self-service for every digital feature that follows.

slots.name: node14.text
slots.synthetic_source_example: Online scheduling, digital intake and price estimates.

slots.name: node16.text
slots.synthetic_source_example: Patients ask for it, and competitors already offer it.

slots.name: node18.text
slots.synthetic_source_example: Fewer calls, fewer no-shows and cleaner claims.

slots.name: node22.text
slots.synthetic_source_example: Referral tracking, care plans and a virtual front desk.

slots.name: node24.text
slots.synthetic_source_example: Not yet: it needs the event stream and clinical capacity.
